deduplication.note: One record per gauge_uid. Cross-network duplicate resolution is performed upstream in nsw_rainfall_stations.csv, not in this build.

selection.rule: live == true AND cls in {A,B,C} AND at least one of mhl_ts_id / wdo_ts_id / waternsw_site non-empty
selection.source_rule: source = mhl if mhl_ts_id else wdo; ts_id = that id

ifd_validation.rule: Each row non-decreasing across AEP columns from common to rare; each column non-decreasing with duration. Exemption: rare columns may decrease at the 1440-1800 minute step only, by at most 5 mm or 3 percent of the 1440 value, whichever is larger. Exempted cells are listed.
